philosophical_theme: CLUSTER: Intellective functions and divine attributes — Knowledge, providence, beauty, necessity
plotinian_parallel: Enneads 5.8 (Intelligible beauty), 3.2–3.3 (Providence), 6.8 (On free will and divine knowledge)
charge: The hierarchy potentially denies the sovereignty of God over creation or introduces intermediate emanations competing with divine omnipotence.
defense: Hierarchy is eternal and atemporean. Emanation derives from God's superabundant goodness, not diminishment. Follows Plotinus, Porphyry, Proclus.
notes: T21–T40 constitute the second major cluster. Pico explores how divine intellection, providence, and beauty function in Neoplatonic hierarchy. Likely draws on Plotinus Enneads 3.2, 5.8 and Proclus *Elements of Theology*. Check Copenhaver's Q12 (divine nature) analysis.
